name: WordPress Migrator
description: Migrate a WordPress site to Basehim. Imports posts, pages, categories, tags, users, comments, featured/inline media, custom fields, Yoast/Rank Math SEO meta, menus, and creates 301 redirects from old WordPress URLs. Supports both WXR export files and direct MySQL connections, with a batched wizard that handles large sites without PHP timeouts.
author: Basehim Team
